Coram : R.K. AGRAWAL*, S. ABDUL NAZEER
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 – s.11(6) r/w s.11(9) – Appointment of arbitrator – The scope under s.11(6) read with s.11(9) is very limited to the extent of appointment of Arbitrator – The Court has to see whether there exists an Arbitration Agreement between the of appointment of Arbitrator, court has not to touch the merits of the case as it may cause prejudice to the case of the parties – In the instant case, arbitration clause existed in the contract – Accordingly, sole arbitrator appointed to adjudicate the disputes. Disposing of
